title: Automate security questionnaire routing and attestation bundles for legal & sales handoff
creator: Aisha Mehta
description:
Background: Enterprise sales and legal spend substantial cycles answering SIG/CAIQ questionnaires and assembling customer attestation bundles. Current process is manual: sales requests, PM/SE curate artifacts, legal assembles shipment, and pricing teams negotiate credits for extensive evidence requests. This creates friction in close cycles and inconsistent pricing adjustments.

Goal: Automate routing of incoming security questionnaires (SIG/CAIQ and vendor-specific) to the appropriate internal owner, auto-generate a curated attestation bundle based on customer profile and contractual tier, and expose a pricing adjustment recommendation to Sales and Finance for faster negotiations.

Success metrics (primary):
- Reduce average enterprise security response lead time from 11 business days to <= 3 business days.
- Decrease manual assembly hours per questionnaire by 70%.
- Increase close rate on deals requiring attestations by +6 percentage points in pilot accounts.

Scope:
Included: Built-in mapping for SIG/CAIQ standard questions to Redwood canonical answers, rules engine to select evidence artifacts by customer tier (self-attestation, verifiable docs, SOC reports), automated email routing to SE/Legal owners, and a pricing-recommendation flag for Sales (no/partial/full credit).
Excluded: Full replacement of legal review; highly-customized questionnaires that require product changes; on-prem audit support.

Proposed approach:
1) Add webhook endpoint for incoming vendor questionnaire submissions (Sales/SE/GDrive upload).
2) Run classification pipeline that matches questionnaire format to known templates (SIG/CAIQ versioning, custom vendor forms).
3) Populate canonical answer set and attach evidence artifacts from the evidence library (Drive/Confluence/S3).
4) Rules engine determines customer impact level and recommended pricing accommodation.
5) Package result into a draft attestation bundle for Legal review and send to Sales with a one-click approve/submit flow.

Trade-offs considered:
- Accuracy vs speed: we prioritize reducing turnaround time with a human-review gate to prevent incorrect attestations.
- Evidence centralization: building a canonical evidence library requires initial manual curation but reduces long-term maintenance.
- Pricing automation sensitivity: recommendations are advisory; final adjustments require Finance approval.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 1 (pilot, 4 weeks): automate routing + canonical answer generation for SIG/CAIQ only, pilot with three enterprise accounts.
- Phase 2 (8 weeks): expand to include common vendor forms, attach evidence library, integrate pricing recommendation into Salesforce.
- Phase 3 (ongoing): add learning loop from Legal edits to improve canonical answers and surface quantized metrics in Console.

Risks and mitigations:
- Incorrect canonical answers: mitigation = mandatory Legal/SE sign-off and audit trail for changes.
- Evidence gaps for older products: mitigation = targeted curation sprint and temporary manual fallback.
- Sales adoption friction: mitigation = baked-in UX for one-click approve + education session for GTM.

Success criteria for promotion to Done:
- Pilot meets lead-time and manual-hours reduction targets.
- Legal signs off on audit trail and review workflow.
- Sales & Finance accept pricing recommendation flow for pilot cohort.
